steps.expression: (() => { const old=window.__zcodePdfDebug; old?.dispose?.(); const records=[]; const redactCsp=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/nonce-[^'\s;]+/gi,'nonce-<redacted>').replace(/sha(?:256|384|512)-[^'\s;]+/gi,'sha-<redacted>'); const csp=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('meta[http-equiv]')].filter(e=>String(e.httpEquiv).toLowerCase()==='content-security-policy').map(e=>redactCsp(e.content)); const snapshot=(phase)=>{ const style=document.querySelector('[data-zcode-pptx-print-style]'); const host=document.querySelector('[data-zcode-pptx-print-host]'); let sheetAccessible=false,ruleCount=0,hasPrint=false,hasPage=false,stylesheetError; try { const rules=style?.sheet?.cssRules; sheetAccessible=!!rules; ruleCount=rules?.length??0; for(const rule of rules??[]) { const text=String(rule.cssText||''); if(text.includes('@media print')||rule.conditionText==='print') hasPrint=true; if(text.includes('@page')) hasPage=true; } } catch(error) { stylesheetError=error?.name||'stylesheet_error'; } const computed=host?getComputedStyle(host):null; const rect=host?.getBoundingClientRect(); records.push({kind:'snapshot',phase,mediaPrint:matchMedia('(print)').matches,stylePresent:!!style,hostPresent:!!host,styleSheetAccessible:sheetAccessible,ruleCount,hasPrintRule:hasPrint,hasPageRule:hasPage,stylesheetError:stylesheetError||null,hostStyle:computed?{position:computed.position,transform:computed.transform,display:computed.display,visibility:computed.visibility,zIndex:computed.zIndex,width:rect?.width??0,height:rect?.height??0}:null,csp:csp()}); if(records.length>32) records.shift(); }; const onViolation=(event)=>{ records.push({kind:'securitypolicyviolation',blockedURI:String(event.blockedURI||''),violatedDirective:String(event.violatedDirective||''),effectiveDirective:String(event.effectiveDirective||'')}); }; const onBefore=()=>snapshot('beforeprint'); const onAfter=()=>snapshot('afterprint'); const observer=new MutationObserver((mutations)=>{ if(mutations.some(m=>[...m.addedNodes,...m.removedNodes].some(node=>node.nodeType===1&&((node.matches?.('[data-zcode-pptx-print-style]'))||(node.matches?.('[data-zcode-pptx-print-host]')))))) snapshot('mutation'); }); addEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',onViolation); addEventListener('beforeprint',onBefore); addEventListener('afterprint',onAfter); observer.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true}); window.__zcodePdfDebug={records,capture:()=>snapshot('probe'),dispose:()=>{removeEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',onViolation);removeEventListener('beforeprint',onBefore);removeEventListener('afterprint',onAfter);observer.disconnect();}}; snapshot('setup'); })()
